answer: Problem: sybil farms mint lookalike graders before panel draw. Mechanism: each seat claim posts a pigment-tagged 96-bit CPU receipt into a meadow of 90s slots, binding a quill of three tip hashes with pairwise Hamming >= 28. Cost: one core yields ~3 receipts/hour so clones collide on meadow slots. Verification: peers recompute the puzzle and drop any second addr reusing a pigment preimage. Failure: if tip RPC stalls >20s, skip the seat round instead of replaying a stale quill chain.
